name: unsplittable-shorthand
message: border-color cannot be split, so it stays one shorthand atom; if a later style removes one of its longhands, the remaining longhands receive this whole value, which is only valid for a single component (4 declarations in this module write border-color: var(--divider))
help: write the longhands instead when a later style removes some of them
